This page highlights selected academic, research, teaching, and professional achievements.

## Academic Milestones

- Postdoctoral Fellow, University of South Carolina, January 2025 - Present.
- Ph.D. in Industrial Engineering, West Virginia University, 2024.
- Dissertation: *A Data-driven Time-Series Analytics Framework for Smart Manufacturing Systems*.

## Research Contributions

- Published research on time-series forecasting, classification, and pattern recognition in smart manufacturing systems.
- Contributed to research on real-time defect detection in robotic assembly lines.
- Contributed to research on digital twin enabled robot collision detection.
- Contributed to research on federated learning and blockchain-enabled collaborative manufacturing analytics.

## Teaching and Mentoring

- Co-Lecturer for Applied Systems Engineering for Complex Systems, INDE 561, University of South Carolina, Fall 2025.
- Graduate Teaching Assistant at West Virginia University for systems engineering, manufacturing processes, and engineering data analysis courses.
- Mentored and guided student teams through real-world engineering problem-solving and capstone-style project work.

## Grants and Funded Projects

- Contributed to NSF-funded research on manufacturing time-series analytics at West Virginia University.
